snippet.title: Daddy Yankee  en vivo Premio Latin GRAMMY 2026
snippet.description:
Daddy Yankee  en vivo Premio Latin GRAMMY 2026



Daddy Yankee protagonizó uno de los momentos más memorables de los Latin GRAMMY 2026 con una presentación histórica en honor a su reconocimiento como Persona del Año. En un espectacular medley de diez canciones, El Big Boss recorrió los grandes éxitos que marcaron su trayectoria y transformaron la música global, acompañado por invitados especiales como Bizarrap, LL Cool J, Jay Wheeler, Fresh Montana, Bad Gyal, Feid y la superestrella india Diljit Dosanjh. Jay Wheeler interpretó “Ella Me Levantó”, mientras Fresh Montana se sumó a “Con Calma”. Desde “Dura”, “Despacito” y “Gasolina” hasta “POKITO”, su más reciente colaboración, la presentación conectó generaciones, culturas y mercados, reafirmando la vigencia de su legado y su influencia en la música mundial. Una noche que rindió homenaje a quien no solo hizo historia en el reggaetón, sino que continúa escribiendo su próximo capítulo

snippet.title: Missy Mazzoli’s Lincoln in the Bardo: Live Stream Trailer
snippet.description:
On November 14, the Metropolitan Opera presents a free live stream on YouTube of Missy Mazzoli and librettist Royce Vavrek’s critically acclaimed new opera, based on the award-winning novel by George Saunders. Music Director Yannick Nézet-Séguin conducts the dazzling production by Lileana Blain-Cruz.

American composer Missy Mazzoli arrives at the Met with a bewitching adaptation of George Saunders’s Booker Prize–winning novel. Set in the “bardo,” the intermediate state between this life and the next, the opera examines Abraham Lincoln’s grief following the loss of his son and follows the boy as he struggles to move on to the next life. To tell this otherworldly story, Mazzoli crafts a score that draws inspiration from leading contemporary composers while conjuring a genre-defying sound-world distinctly her own.

This broadcast supports the company’s Make the Met Forever campaign. Every generation needs guardians of remarkable art, culture, and music. The powerful shared experience of opera—with its singular fusion of music, drama, dance, and design—is one of our greatest cultural treasures. Forever starts with you—make your gift today at https://metopera.org/support/make-the-met-forever/donate/?source=2439817

The captioned stream will remain available on YouTube through midnight ET on November 18.

Watch at https://youtube.com/live/RqtQ162dIqg

---

Guidance: Suggested for ages 13+

Lincoln in the Bardo contains adult themes and discussions of suicide. For more detail, read the complete synopsis: https://www.metopera.org/discover/synopses/lincoln-in-the-bardo/

This production contains flashing-light effects, atmospheric effects, and loud sound effects.

snippet.title: Gatto | Official Trailer | In Theaters March 5, 2027
snippet.description:
this cat’s on his last life...

Set in the feline-run underbelly of Venice, Italy, Gatto releases exclusively in theaters March 5, 2027.

Previously announced voice cast members Mark Ruffalo, Laurence Fishburne and Enrico Casarosa (who also serves as director) are joined by Bianca Babaşa as Maja; Sherry Cola as Regina; John Turturro as Capitano Briganti; Rumen Sali Shopov as Papu Janko; Rhys Darby as Focaccia; Isabella Rossellini as Contessa; Natasia Demetriou as Caronte; Jamie Demetriou as Plague Doctor; Jason Schwartzman as Vivaldi; Saverio Raimondo as Ugo; Jason Mantzoukas as Rico; Matt Jones as Enzo; Austin Madison as Fishmonger; Beatrice Manfredi as Martinelli; Jesse Andrews as Bartolomeo; Tracey Ullman as Luisa; and Marco Calvani as Maestro Foscari.

The original score for “Gatto” is composed by Academy Award®-winner Dario Marianelli (“Atonement”). The score features violin compositions co-written and performed by renowned Slovak violinist Barbora Botošová.

In “Gatto,” after years of maneuvering the canal-ridden, superstitious city of Venice, Italy, Nero (voiced by Mark Ruffalo) begins to question whether he’s lived the right lives. Indebted to Rocco (voiced by Laurence Fishburne), the local feline mob boss, Nero finds himself in a quandary and is forced to forge a truly unexpected friendship that may finally lead him to his purpose – unless Venice gets the better of him first. “Gatto” is directed by Enrico Casarosa and produced by Andrea Warren, the filmmaking team behind the Oscar®-nominated feature “Luca.” 

Additionally, “Loving Dory,” a new animated short from Disney and Pixar set in the world of “Finding Nemo,” will play in theaters ahead of “Gatto.” Ellen DeGeneres returns as the voice of Dory in the short, which follows the forgetful blue tang fish as she finds herself in a hapless “meet-cute” with a plastic bag. Mistaking it for a gentle jellyfish, she's moved by its curious nature and falls head-over-fins in love. But it doesn't take long for her new romantic entanglement to escalate from a little clingy to outright toxic – and in desperate need of intervention! The short is written and directed by Lou Hamou-Lhadj, produced by Mary Alice Drumm and executive produced by Academy Award® winners Pete Docter and Andrew Stanton.

“Gatto” and “Loving Dory” release exclusively in theaters March 5, 2027.

snippet.title: David Banner - Where You From? ft. T.I., Juicy J, Duke Deuce
snippet.description:
David Banner feat. T.I., Juicy J, & Duke Deuce - “Where You From?” [Official Music Video] 
#DavidBanner #TI #JuicyJ #DukeDeuce

STREAM / DOWNLOAD “WHERE YOU FROM?”:
▶ https://found.ee/whereyoufrom

LYRICS:
Aye! Aye!
What the f*ck!

Duke Deuce
Throw your signs
Show them boys where you from
Don’t get blowed we got sticks, we keep drums
Got that crowd going raged, get them crunk
Don’t give a f*ck where you from

T.I.
Yeah, yeah
Ain’t no lacking in my macking
Ask that hoe what’s cracking
Treat her like some action
Escalade or Cadillac and my vernacular was relaxing her
Put her ass off in the passenger
See she know she daddy little freak
All my penthouses and mansions
Acres where my ranch is
Shooters for intruders, we ain’t taking any chances
So elaborate, excessive, I’ll just be applying pressure
I tailor made my garment that’s why details so impressive
So dangerous, intelligent
Been famous for my eloquence
Been addressing elephants in the room ever since
I would say something but I’m hesitant
Because one thing about a dummy man they think they know it all, can’t tell them shit
Misdemeanor, felony
Who else but the king bitch
Know it when you see it, it ain’t hard to distinguish
I’ve got a couple fine bitches tag teaming
Microdosing acid somewhere private, smoking laughing at my demons

Hook
(repeat)

Juicy J
North Memphis rich n*gga, welcome to my city
You looking for an easy come up you might come up missing
Get this money
All I keep is hundreds
You won’t find a fifty, hold up
You won’t find no ones
I made it thunderstorm
My lil Memphis n*ggas carry sticks like a baton. All they want is smoke, they get shit popping just for fun
Ain’t no back and forth
This ain’t table tennis
I might go on tour, bring the whole North Memphis
One bitch won’t do, I need two at a time
Back-to-back in the foreigns look like a funeral line
Blowing gas in the Tesla
High as an extraterrestrial
I just got one request for you hater
Hop off my testicles

Hook
(repeat)

David Banner
Straight up out that Miss
Where a n*gga pack them tools and if we point them we don’t miss
Still something like a pimp, you just might find me with your Ms.
N•gga trip
Big clip it holds 100 in that bitch
We get to running in your shit, yeah hoe!
We’re from a city where you rap, you play sports or you sell dope
We don’t tolerate no rats so you gone die if you tell hoe
Big fish off in that water something like a whale hoe
And all my niggas are trained to go and we don’t run no railroad
M-I crooked crooked I crooked crooked I-P-P-I
Self-made, DYI (Defend Your Imagination)
Ain’t no lie
We treat beef like BBQ
D.O.A.
Keep that fire
Cock that back
bow, bow, bow
RIP

Hook

snippet.title: Half Alive (From The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping - The Album) (Official Music Video)
snippet.description:
Official Music Video for "Half Alive." 

Listen to "Half Alive" here: https://TheHungerGames.lnk.to/HalfAlive
Listen to The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping (The Album) here: https://www.hungergamessoundtrack.com/

Subscribe to Mckenna's channel: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCljX1tdPl0cVS17OQzzflWQ?sub_confirmation=1

TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@mckennagrace?lang=en
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/mckennagraceful/?hl=en
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/MckennaGraceful
Website: https://www.mckennagrace.com/

Lyrics:

I clean the floor with all the tears left here before me 
Diggin’ my heels into the dirt, won’t fall to my knees  
And all the vultures who want me dead say they adore me 
I’m scared to sleep cause so much changes by the morning 
I’m barely holding on 

My finest ribbons on as I walk to the gallows 
I try but I’m defined by all that I can’t let go 
So call me vile, cruel and bad like I’m an animal 
Tell me to beg and bare my teeth like some sick joke 
Watch as the man plays God 

Won’t hang my head, won’t plead for my life 
They’ll leave me here broken, so just stay by my side 
We feel the unspoken, the look in your eyes 
Promise you’ll hold me, when I’m half alive 
  
I was a sister once, I carry that love closely  
Somehow it haunts me where I go  like that role chose me 
I say I’m mean and tough and I don’t care ‘cause I’m not weak 
But if tomorrow was my last, hope someone mourns me 
Watch as they all applaud 

Won’t hang my head, won't plead for my life 
They’ll leave me here broken so just stay by my side 
We feel the unspoken, the look in your eyes 
Promise you’ll hold me when I’m half alive 

Nobody cares or knows you ‘til you’re just a body 
I fought I pulled away but you, you always saw me 
You’re bruised and bloody, and I’m trying to act softly  
Oh I’m … half alive 

Promise you’ll hold me when I’m half alive 

#MckennaGrace #HungerGames #SunriseontheReaping

snippet.title: Middle of America
snippet.description:
you won't like the things I'm sayin
but I heard em on the wind
they have driven me around
I've been hiding out from them

and they bite my like the winter
they freeze me like the ice
I'd be naive to call it truth
and cynical to call it lies

yea it's something in between
so it might be something true
this whole world is so damn ugly
when you paint it red and blue

I am in the middle of america
tryna find my way
takin it day by day
I am in the middle of america
takin the whole thing in 
lookin at where we've been

and he was always in a hurry
asking people who he was
back when jesus walked the earth
jus like everybody does

and they built the man a temple
soon as he was safely dead
and they love to go and hurt you
saying things they say he said

there must be something in between
yea there must be something true
if I'm my brother's keeper
then what am I to you?

I am in the middle of america
tryna find my way
taking it day by day
I am in the middle of america
taking the whole thing in
looking at where we've been

I ain't offering an answer
I'm jus holdin up a sign
you can lead a horse to water
but you can't make it wonder why

if it's an accident or fate
take this for what it's worth
you don't love it cause it's great
you love your home because it's yours

yea there's something in between
what you hope and what you fear
if this all exists for you
then why the hell are we all here?

I am in the middle of america
tryna find my way
taking it day by day
I am in the middle of america
taking the whole thing in
looking at where we've been

I am in the middle of america
tryna figure it out
what the whole thing's about
I am in the middle of america
tryna find my way
takin it day by day
out here in the land

Letra

Sí, ya sé
Que ganar lo que yo tengo tiene un precio
Yo así decidí crecer
Me critican y me dicen que ando recio
Creen que uno no sabe que se siente el hambre
Y obligarse a dormir nomás pa' aguantarse
Todo es diferente gracias a mi madre
Que en las malas me ha enseñado a levantarme
Y aunque ahora hay billetes eso no me hace grande
Los lujitos deslumbran a los farsantes
Viejón, ahí voy
Solo deje que termine unos asuntos
Pero ya estamos mejor
A mi amá le compré casa y sin los puntos
Me llena de orgullo verla bien contenta
Siendo que ayer no acabábamos la renta
Pasé de un futuro y una vida incierta
A un presente donde se me abren las puertas
Ya nadie me dice, ya nadie me cuenta
Este mundo nomás es pa'l que se avienta
Y hay que aventarse, viejones

Ya no estoy
Pa' mamadas tampoco pa' chingaderas
Creo que ya les demostré
Que yo estoy corriendo mi propia carrera
En mentes pequeñas no entran sueños grandes
Que era un loco así decían los ignorantes
Dejé atrás los miedos y las limitantes
Me enfoqué nomás en darle pa' delante
Ahora la muñeca llena de brillantes
Fue mi culpa por ser muy terco y constante
Sacrifiqué
Tiempo con familia y también diversiones
Arrepentido jamás
Porque ahorita todo lo disfruto el doble
Carro pa' mi padre y pa' mi amá una casa
Es el resultado de un a ver qué pasa
El que no lo intenta es el que fracasa
Y aquel que no se rinde es el que la cuaja
Yo sigo al tirante con toda mi raza
Dejé claro que los sueños se trabajan

snippet.title: Call of Duty MW4 Is Secretly Training Gen Z (for better and worse)
snippet.description:
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is teaching Gen Z a lot more than how to shoot. We compare MW4’s maneuver warfare, night vision, thermal, drones, and CQB against real gear and real tactics, covering what the game gets right and what it gets wrong.

Lots of channels have done “the guns of COD in real life.” This video covers everything else. MW4’s campaign quietly teaches pin-and-flank and L-shaped assaults, how auto-gain night vision behaves, why thermal can’t see through glass, how drone operators hide, and why “clear” is a promise you don’t make until the room is actually clear. We put real night vision, thermal, and fusion footage side by side with the game to show where Infinity Ward nailed it and where it misses.

snippet.title: Tyler Crowe - Snakes Don't Shows Their Fangs
snippet.description:
Not everyone standing beside you is standing with you. Some people hide their true intentions behind smiles, friendship, and fake loyalty.

“Snakes Don't Show Their Fangs” by Tyler Crowe is a soulful Southern R&B song about fake friends, hidden jealousy, betrayal, and learning who truly deserves your trust.

Sometimes the closest people are the ones you need to watch the most.

🎧 Listen, feel the message, and share your thoughts in the comments.

Subscribe to Tyler Crowe for more original music.

**Artist:** Tyler Crowe  
**Song:** Snakes Don't Show Their Fangs  
**Genre:** Southern R&B / Southern Soul  
**Release:** Original Music

Full Lyrics 

**[Intro]**

Back in the day, you knew who stood against you.
Now everybody's smiling, everybody's playing nice.
But life taught me one thing...
Not every hand you shake wishes you well.

[Verse 1]
I used to think an enemy would show his face,
Now they sit beside you, smiling in your space.
They ask about your dreams, tell you that they care,
Then turn around and act like you were never there.

I gave a few my trust, I gave a few my time,
Shared my deepest feelings, let them see inside my mind.
They celebrated with me when the good days came,
But when the tables turned, they never stayed the same.

Some people want your sunshine but don't want you to shine,
They'll tell you that they're happy while they're wishing you decline.
I stopped explaining everything I had to do,
Because everybody listening ain't really listening for you.

[Pre-Chorus]
Watch the actions, not the words,
Some lessons have to hurt.
A smile can hide a thousand lies,
And time will open up your eyes.

[Chorus]
Snakes don't show their fangs no more,
They walk right through your front door.
Sit at your table, call you brother,
Then talk against you when they're with another.

They smile when you're winning, disappear when you fall,
Say they'll always be there, never answer when you call.
Everybody talks about loyalty, but few know what it means,
Sometimes the closest faces hide the darkest things.

[Verse 2]
My old man told me, keep your plans inside,
Not everybody wants to see you reach the other side.
Some are asking questions just to learn your next move,
Some are keeping score of everything you do.

They remember every failure, forget the help you gave,
Come around when you're successful, disappear when you need saving.
I used to wonder why the people changed their ways,
Now I understand some only loved my yesterday.

I don't hate nobody, I just learned to see,
Not everybody standing close belongs with me.
I'd rather walk alone than live a life of lies,
A peaceful heart is worth more than a thousand fake replies.

[Chorus]
Snakes don't show their fangs no more,
They walk right through your front door.
Sit at your table, call you brother,
Then talk against you when they're with another.

They smile when you're winning, disappear when you fall,
Say they'll always be there, never answer when you call.
Everybody talks about loyalty, but few know what it means,
Sometimes the closest faces hide the darkest things.

[Verse 3]
I lost a couple friends when I started doing well,
Funny how their attitude was something time would tell.
They liked me when I struggled, when I had nowhere to go,
But when I found my footing, they didn't want to know.

Real friends don't compete with you, they celebrate your name,
They don't make you feel guilty every time you make a change.
They stand beside you quietly when life gets hard,
And never use your weakness to leave another scar.

So I keep my circle small, my expectations low,
I let my actions speak and let the truth unfold.
I don't need a crowded room to prove that I'm alright,
One honest soul is worth a thousand fake goodbyes.

[Bridge]
Listen carefully...

Not everybody who praises you is proud of you.
Not everybody who knows your story deserves to hear your future.
And forgiveness doesn't mean you have to open every door again.

Sometimes moving forward means leaving certain people behind.

[Final Chorus]
Snakes don't show their fangs no more,
They walk right through your front door.
Sit at your table, call you family,
But secretly they wish you weren't where you wanna be.

They smile when you're winning, disappear when you fall,
Say they'll always be there, never answer when you call.
I don't carry hatred, I just finally understand,
Sometimes your biggest enemy is shaking your hand.

[Outro]
The streets taught me to watch for enemies.
Life taught me to watch for fake friends.

I don't wish anybody bad.
I just know who deserves a place in my life.

Because these days...

The snake ain't hiding in the grass.

He's sitting right beside you.

Angry Video Game Nerd episode 236: Cliffhanger (NES, Game Boy, Game Gear, Amiga, Genesis, SNES, Sega CD). The Nerd charts a course up both 1993 games based on the Sylvester Stallone movie, from lowly side-scrollers to the higher peak of beat ’em ups. Taking out bad guys on a frozen mountain should make for an awesome game... instead it’s bats, spike pits, and the "worst gun on NES." snippet.title: So I Played And Ranked EVERY Fallout DLC...
snippet.description:

After each DLC is played (including a majority of side content), I'll rank said DLC and place it on my tier list... taking into consideration; Gameplay, companions, locations, unique weapons/armors and enemy variety... Aswell as written story ofcourse.

snippet.title: Firearms Expert Reacts to SULFUR Guns | EXP
snippet.description:
EXP is the premium destination for your favourite expert-driven content, all funded by the fans. Get early access and extended episodes every week at: https://Patreon.com/WatchEXP

EXP Merch is available now! Go to https://expvideo.info to check out our Cursed and Core Collection, including T-Shirts, Hoodies, Pint Glasses, Posters, and Stickers!

Jonathan Ferguson, an expert in firearms history, and the Keeper of Firearms & Artillery at the Royal Armouries Museum in the UK, reacts to the utterly unhinged weapons of SULFUR, including the Ferryman ‘Anti-Materiel SMG’, the Arbiter 2 triple-barreled sawed-off shotgun and an LMG with the most painful reload animation we’ve ever seen.

Shout-out to Donkquad for the thumbnail art! 

00:00 - Intro
01:22 - P38 Dirk
03:27 - Mossman
05:07 - Chat-Pardeur 98
07:42 - Arbiter 2
10:21 - Nightlily 318
11:57 - Ripox Mowlock
15:34 - Why not check out our Patreon?
16:06 - Impala Gravita
17:20 - Flicker
18:30 - Ferryman
20:01 - Salamander
22:36 - Termite
24:28 - Neuraxis F22
27:10 - Breacher 8
29:08 - M11A2 Fisk

In this episode of Expert Reacts on EXP, Jonathan Ferguson--an expert in firearms history and the Keeper of Firearms & Artillery at the Royal Armouries Museum in the UK--breaks down the guns of SULFUR, and compares them to their real-life counterparts with artefacts from the Royal Armouries archive.

If you're interested in seeing more of Jonathan's work, you can check out more from the Royal Armouries right here. - https://www.youtube.com/user/RoyalArmouries  

If you would like to support the Royal Armouries, you can make a charitable donation to the museum here. - https://royalarmouries.org/support-us/donate

And if you would like to become a member of the Royal Armouries, you can get a membership here. - https://royalarmouries.org/support-us/become-a-member

You can purchase Jonathan's book here. - https://www.headstamppublishing.com/bullpup-rifle-book

snippet.title: ROBLOX DON'T STOP DRIVING...
snippet.description:
Roblox Do Not Stop is a terrifying horror game where a monster kills us if we stop driving. I recruited my brother to survive.

In this Roblox horror game, we have to keep moving to stay alive. My brother @DingusGoobers and I tackle several routes, starting with an easy path before moving up to a medium county road and a hard highway. We eventually test our skills on White Out Ridge, which is the hardest level in the entire game. If you enjoy scary Roblox driving games, this session is packed with intense monster chase moments.

We coordinate our efforts to manage the window, back shutter, and scanner while keeping the car moving. It takes perfect teamwork to survive the hardest challenges, and we find out exactly how haunting the monster looks when it gets too close. If you like funny Roblox moments with brothers, you will love watching us try to beat the levels nobody is supposed to finish.
